h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Punjab & Jammu and Kashmir

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Punjab & Jammu and Kashmir

items.pText: Punjab is flat, fertile and well connected by road, which makes it a straightforward state for us to supply. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing societies, municipal parks, gurdwara and temple trusts, farmhouses and hotels in Punjab, and for sites in Jammu and Kashmir further north.

Ludhiana is an industrial city with many private schools and new housing colonies. Amritsar has the Golden Temple, a steady flow of visitors and hotels that want a play area for families. Jalandhar is known for sports goods and has schools with large playing fields, and Patiala and Mohali have colleges and planned residential areas. We build all equipment at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and send it by road. Our installation team or a dealer in north India installs it, grouted or self-standing. For Jammu and Kashmir, where snow and the short building season change the plan, we have a separate page, linked below.

richText.heading: Heat, winter fog and school grounds

c: Punjab summers are very hot and dry, and winters are cold with dense fog. Metal slides heat up quickly in May and June, so roto-moulded slides and decks are a better choice for open school grounds. Plant trees on the west side of the play area if you can. In winter, fog leaves surfaces damp in the morning, so rubber flooring under swings and climbers helps.
Schools here often want equipment that a whole class can use at once. A multi play system from our
combines slides, climbers and decks in one structure. Ludhiana buyers can read our

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a gurdwara or temple trust order playground equipment?
items.a: Yes. Trusts often add a small play area in the garden or near the community hall. Share the space available and photos, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing.

items.q: Is roto-moulded plastic better than metal in Punjab's summer?
items.a: For slides and decks in full sun, yes. Roto-moulded plastic does not get as hot to the touch as bare metal. Our posts and frames are galvanised steel for strength.

items.q: Do you install playgrounds in smaller Punjab towns?
items.a: Yes. Punjab has good road links, so we can reach most towns and villages. Our team or a dealer in north India installs the equipment after dispatch from Vasai.
